notes.title: Early Access Build 1.12
notes.notes:
These patch notes come along with an update, though they also include some undocumented changes I put out in very small updates over the past week or so (in chronological order).

[list]
[*] Split the centered speed display setting into an upper and lower option that determines whether the display is shown above or below the crosshair.
[*] Fixed an issue where fully resetting a map on the same tick that you respawn at a checkpoint grants you the checkpoint after fully resetting.
[*] Fixed new keybinds reappearing if you add and delete them in the same play session.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.11
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The speed display setting is now a dropdown with an additional "Centered" option. This option will show the speed display just above the crosshair.
[*] Slightly changed how text looks and how it's scaled with resolution.
[*] Fixed an issue where the time of a replay in the replay viewer would be different than the time saved to the file.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.1
notes.notes: [p]This is a bigger update than the previous small patches since I've made the first change that breaks replay compatibility across the game. If you want to go back and view your old replays, I've put up a beta version which will allow you to watch old replays. To download that version, right click Blast Processed in your Steam library -> Properties -> Betas and select the "replay_compatibility" beta.[/p][p][/p][p]Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Extended the buffer window for perfect slides and perfect bunnyhops.[/p][/*][*][p]Some players weren't realizing you can return to your current checkpoint at will by pressing R (by default), so now the game will show a reminder if you fall for too long, which should show up in Paradise if you fall all the way to the kill plane from a higher jump. You can disable this reminder completely in the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the wording of the basic tutorial to draw more attention to reset binds.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the wording of the perfect slide tutorial to make the benefit of perfect slides more clear.[/p][/*][*][p]Using a reset bind now resets the timer and starts a new replay if you don't have a checkpoint. (This should actually work now, please let me know if you find any issues with it)[/p][/*][*][p]Added an optional bind for completely resetting maps. This action is not bound to any key by default, but it can be found in the key bindings section of the options menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the ability to fully reset a map by using a reset bind while paused. Bind a key to the dedicated reset map action instead for fast resets.[/p][/*][/list][p]Map Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a pixel walk in Metropolis on the jump Cross Launch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the beam of sunlight at the end of Palace acting as a solid wall for rockets.[/p][/*][*][p]Made several jumps in Brimstone a bit more lenient.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.06
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Using reset binds in the pause menu is now restricted to the initial menu and only works on full maps.
[*] Fixed hit indicators appearing during replay loading.
[*] Fixed the tooltip for the input display setting.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.05
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New Feature: Hit Indicators
[*] By default, you'll now be shown the horizontal direction you've been hit by a rocket from. This HUD element can be disabled in the options menu.
[*] Reverted the changes made to reset binds in 1.02, since they may be causing desyncs.
[*] Using a reset bind while the game is paused will now fully restart the map and begin recording a new replay.
[*] Fixed incomplete replays sometimes being deleted when they shouldn't be.
[*] Fixed error handling for invalid/corrupted replays.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.04
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed Dynamic FOV and Strafe Lean toggles not loading from the settings file on startup.
[*] Replays may load a little bit faster now.
[/list]
I'm also aware of a bug with borderless fullscreen that causes the window to be misaligned on startup. If you run into this bug, please let me know what sort of monitor setup you have (number of monitors, resolutions, etc.), since I've been unable to replicate it on multiple computers.

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.03
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the final map being visible when it hasn't been unlocked yet in certain cases.
[*] Fixed a typo in the options menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Build 1.02
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Disabled the ability to bind mouse wheel to actions. This didn't work properly and was just causing confusion.
[*] Using a reset bind before reaching a checkpoint will now reset the timer and start recording a new replay.
[*] Using a reset bind no longer starts the timer at the start of a map.
[*] Made a few medal times a bit more lenient. Congratulations to anyone who achieved them before this!
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Map Tweaks
notes.notes:
This update has some balance changes to maps, particularly the surf tutorial in Metropolis which was unreasonably difficult for several people.

Unfortunately, the updates I've made to Paradise, Metropolis, and Palace mean that any replays recorded on these maps in the previous version will not be viewable on the new version, since those changes may cause desyncs. Your best times are still saved and will be displayed when you go to select the map, but you won't be able to watch or race against them. I want to get these replay breaking changes out of the way as soon as possible before people really start speedrunning, so hopefully this isn't too much of an inconvenience to anyone this soon after launch.

notes.title: Colorblind Fix
notes.notes: The colorblind filter option wasn't working correctly on release, but that is now fixed.
